title: The Bible in a year
shortDescription: A little Old Testament and a little New Testament every day.
description: Read the whole Bible in 365 days. Each day pairs a reading from the Old Testament with one from the New, so you're never far from the story of Jesus while you work through the history, poetry and prophets. Miss a day? Pick up where you left off; the plan waits for you.
credits: Reading plan by Bible Scroll. Daily times are estimated from the World English Bible at about 200 words a minute.
